item.title: Passengers face further cancellations as US flights slowly resume after ground stop
item.description: While flights in the United States started resuming on Saturday following the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years, more than 2,000 flights have been cancelled as airlines work to return to normal operations. Nearly 6,000 flights were cancelled on Friday, with the incident marking only the second time an alert to ground all flights had been issued in US airspace since the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: France secures thrilling Nations Championship victory over South Africa
item.description: France smashed world ⁠champion South ​Africa's hopes of lifting the first Nations Championship trophy on Friday, in a ​21-19 defeat for Les Bleus.

item.title: Gambia's Adama Barrow seeks third term
item.description: In tonight's programme, Gambia's electoral commission has announced the five official candidates for the country's upcoming presidential election. President Adama Barrow is seeking a third term. Tensions continue to rise in Ethiopia following the federal government's appointment of a new head of the Western Tigray region. And the Dakar Youth Olympic Games come to a close after two weeks of intense competition.

item.title: France among five major powers to represent EU in Ukraine talks
item.description: European Council President Antonio Costa on Friday said that Brussels will send diplomats from the bloc and five countries, including the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Poland, to upcoming Ukraine talks.
